properties.name: Srinubabu Gedela (OMICS)
properties.group: Predatory operators
properties.detail: Founder of OMICS; the US FTC won a $50.1M judgment against his companies for deceptive publishing and conferences.

properties.name: Ukraine-linked mill network
properties.group: Fake-paper factories that sell authorship (paper mills)
properties.detail: A group of companies flooded ~380 journals with ~1,500 suspect papers since 2017 - possibly Europe's largest mill (Nature, 2025).

properties.name: 'International Publisher' LLC
properties.group: Fake-paper factories that sell authorship (paper mills)
properties.detail: Russia-based mill documented by Anna Abalkina; sold co-authorship slots on papers. Russian journals later retracted 800+ articles.
properties.note: One of the best-documented mills; sells authorship before a ghostwriter even writes the paper.

properties.name: Joachim Boldt
properties.group: Named scientists with the most fabricated or retracted papers
properties.detail: German anaesthesiologist; the all-time record-holder for retractions after fabricating data and forging ethics approvals.

properties.name: Yoshitaka Fujii
properties.group: Named scientists with the most fabricated or retracted papers
properties.detail: Japanese anaesthesiologist who fabricated data across ~170 papers - for years the record-holder.
properties.note: A statistician calculated the odds of his 'natural' data as astronomically small.

properties.name: AI / LLM-generated papers
properties.group: Enablers: citation rings, hijacked journals, AI-written papers, essay mills
properties.detail: ChatGPT-style text is flooding journals; sleuths flag 'tortured phrases' and a surge of 'prolific debutante' authors and AI-written peer reviews.

properties.name: Tadpole paper mill
properties.group: Fake-paper factories that sell authorship (paper mills)
properties.detail: Chinese mill exposed by Elisabeth Bik (2020): hundreds of papers sharing identical western-blot images shaped like tadpoles.

properties.name: Essay & contract-cheating mills
properties.group: Enablers: citation rings, hijacked journals, AI-written papers, essay mills
properties.detail: Commercial services write essays, theses and papers for a fee; banned in several countries but still vast.
properties.note: Kenya is a documented global hub for academic ghostwriting.

properties.name: Hijacked / cloned journals
properties.group: Enablers: citation rings, hijacked journals, AI-written papers, essay mills
properties.detail: Fake clone websites impersonate real indexed journals to sell publication slots; the Retraction Watch Hijacked Journal Checker lists 450+.

properties.name: Chinese contract-paper services
properties.group: Fake-paper factories that sell authorship (paper mills)
properties.detail: Commercial services in China that write or sell papers to meet hospital and university publication quotas — a major documented source of fabricated work.

properties.name: Tanu.pro / Russian authorship market
properties.group: Fake-paper factories that sell authorship (paper mills)
properties.detail: Russian-language platform documented by investigators selling authorship slots and citations in indexed journals.

properties.name: Yoshihiro Sato
properties.group: Named scientists with the most fabricated or retracted papers
properties.detail: Japanese bone researcher who fabricated clinical-trial data over decades.

properties.name: Hironobu Ueshima
properties.group: Named scientists with the most fabricated or retracted papers
properties.detail: Japanese anaesthesiologist with scores of fabricated studies.

properties.name: Andrew Wakefield
properties.group: Named scientists with the most fabricated or retracted papers
properties.detail: His 1998 Lancet paper linking the MMR vaccine to autism was retracted; he was struck off the UK medical register. The fraud fuelled global vaccine hesitancy.

properties.name: Olive Academic
properties.group: Fake-paper factories that sell authorship (paper mills)
properties.detail: Chinese mill linked to large batches of image-duplicated biomedical papers.

properties.name: Citation cartels
properties.group: Enablers: citation rings, hijacked journals, AI-written papers, essay mills
properties.detail: Groups of authors, editors and journals that cite each other to inflate impact factors and h-indices.

properties.name: ARDA / authorship-for-sale sites

properties.detail: Russian sites that openly sell authorship positions in indexed journals.

properties.name: Iran-based mills
properties.group: Fake-paper factories that sell authorship (paper mills)

properties.name: India-based mills
properties.group: Fake-paper factories that sell authorship (paper mills)
